annotations.title: Get a link to connect a social account

description: Creates a one-hour link the user opens in a browser to connect a social account (TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Bluesky…) to their PostWire account. Nothing is connected until the user completes it on the page. With brand_id the account is connected to that brand. Returns the url of that page.

brand_id.description: Brand to connect it to. Omit for the default brand.

platform.description: Platform to connect. Omit to let the user choose on the page.
